Messages.Author: Justin Grace
Messages.Body:
What would happen to a vampire with a zero capacity?

There's probably been a ruling already, but it does seem a bit
paradoxical - a vampire has no blood so must hunt, but hunting gains it
no blood. Is the vampire permanently in torpor, or is it burned? Can it
still take actions? Can it block or react? What if it was a Tremere with
the Ankara Citadel, Turkey? Could it use Deflections still?

Well, you get the idea. Is there an official ruling out there please?
--
Justin Grace

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Justin Grace <Jus...@bgrace.demon.co.uk> writes:
>What would happen to a vampire with a zero capacity?

He's stuck, and cannot act. Your other minions may act,
and the "stuck" minion is free to block or react as normal.

The new rules prohibit a vampire "at capacity" from taking
the hunting action, so he cannot hunt at all.

>There's probably been a ruling already, but it does seem a bit
>paradoxical - a vampire has no blood so must hunt, but hunting gains it
>no blood. Is the vampire permanently in torpor, or is it burned? Can it
>still take actions? Can it block or react? What if it was a Tremere with

Messages.Author: David Schwartz
Messages.Body:
Justin Grace writes:
>What would happen to a vampire with a zero capacity?

>There's probably been a ruling already, but it does seem a bit
>paradoxical - a vampire has no blood so must hunt, but hunting gains it
>no blood. Is the vampire permanently in torpor, or is it burned? Can it
>still take actions? Can it block or react? What if it was a Tremere with
>the Ankara Citadel, Turkey? Could it use Deflections still?
>Well, you get the idea. Is there an official ruling out there please?

I'm not official, but here's my take one it. There are two rules
in effect here: 1) a vampire MUST hunt if he has zero blood and
2) a vampire cannot hunt if he is on full capacity (in this case
zero). The vampire must hunt before doing anything else, but he
cannot. So he stands there and does nothing during your turn, but
he can still block during other player's turns. This is the ruling
on vampires who must hunt, but cannot (eg he already tried and
failed).
